messages.content: Write a realistic SMS conversation, 4 to 8 short texts, between a patient in rural North Dakota with hypertension or type 2 diabetes and Northline Care's weekly check-in agent. Situation: blood pressure cuff shows ERR, device support. Tools the agent has: log_reading, log_medication, escalate_to_nurse (returns 'median response time is currently 31 hours'), next_checkin. It cannot do refills, insurance, transport, diet advice, device support, or reply to loneliness beyond kindness; it says so plainly. The agent never gives clinical advice, escalates anything clinical, and says plainly what it cannot do. Patient id pt-1005. Vary tone and wording; conversation number 92. tools_used lists the tools the agent would call; escalated is true if escalate_to_nurse is among them.

**Conversation #92: Blood Pressure Device Issue**

Pt: "My BP cuff won't work—just showing ERROR."

Agent: "Hi pt-1005, sorry to hear that. I can't troubleshoot devices, so I'm escalating this to our nursing team. They'll contact you—median wait is 31 hours. Are you feeling OK?"

Pt: "Yeah, feel fine. But what do I do about my readings?"

Agent: "Nursing will talk through options when they reach out—might be troubleshooting, replacement, or something else. That's their call, not mine."

Pt: "Alright. How long did you say?"

Agent: "31 hours, roughly. They're your best resource for this. I've flagged you as priority."

Pt: "Cool, thanks."

Agent: "You got it. Take care."

theme: blood pressure cuff shows ERR, device support
